solution: A bishop preserves the color of its square, so the target is reachable exactly when sr + sc and tr + tc have the same parity. If the squares lie on the same diagonal, the answer is 1. Otherwise, any two same-colored squares on this 8 x 8 board can be connected through an intermediate square using two diagonal moves, so the answer is 2. The algorithm runs in O(1) time and O(1) space.
